Overview

Coral Springs is a city in FL with a population of 134,000. Family-friendly Broward County suburb with top-rated schools and park system. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees.
